# Goodreads Choice Award for Fiction 2024
The Goodreads Choice Award for Fiction 2024 went to The Wedding People by Alison Espach, from 10 nominees in the final round. The winner and the final-round nominees are chosen by Goodreads members' votes. Goodreads calls this category Readers' Favorite Fiction. Of the 8 on ReadingRate, the easiest to read is I Hope This Finds You Well by Natalie Sue (difficulty 27/100); the hardest is Intermezzo by Sally Rooney (67/100).
[How book difficulty is measured](https://readingrate.com/answers/how-hard-is-a-book-to-read)
## 2024
  * [The Wedding People](https://readingrate.com/books/the-wedding-people) by Alison Espach — difficulty 30/100, about 4.4 hours
  * [Intermezzo](https://readingrate.com/books/intermezzo) by Sally Rooney — finalist
  * Welcome to the Hyunam-dong Bookshop (어서 오세요, 휴남동 서점입니다) by Hwang Boreum, translated by Shanna Tan — finalist
  * [Blue Sisters](https://readingrate.com/books/blue-sisters) by Coco Mellors — finalist
  * [Here One Moment](https://readingrate.com/books/here-one-moment) by Liane Moriarty — finalist
  * Swan Song by Elin Hilderbrand — finalist
  * [Good Material](https://readingrate.com/books/good-material) by Dolly Alderton — finalist
  * [I Hope This Finds You Well](https://readingrate.com/books/i-hope-this-finds-you-well) by Natalie Sue — finalist
  * [Margo's Got Money Troubles](https://readingrate.com/books/margo-s-got-money-troubles) by Rufi Thorpe — finalist
  * [Martyr!](https://readingrate.com/books/martyr) by Kaveh Akbar — finalist


## Questions 

Who won the Goodreads Choice Award for Fiction in 2024?
    The Wedding People by Alison Espach. 

Which books were nominated for the Goodreads Choice Award for Fiction in 2024?
    The Wedding People by Alison Espach, Intermezzo by Sally Rooney, Welcome to the Hyunam-dong Bookshop by Hwang Boreum, Blue Sisters by Coco Mellors, Here One Moment by Liane Moriarty, Swan Song by Elin Hilderbrand, Good Material by Dolly Alderton, I Hope This Finds You Well by Natalie Sue, Margo's Got Money Troubles by Rufi Thorpe and Martyr! by Kaveh Akbar. 

Which 2024 nominee is the easiest to read?
    I Hope This Finds You Well by Natalie Sue, with a difficulty of 27/100, the lowest of the 8 nominees on ReadingRate.
Winners from [the prize’s own page](https://www.goodreads.com/choiceawards/readers-favorite-fiction-books-2024), checked 2026-10-31.

result.title: Candlewood Lake - Wikipedia
result.content: Candlewood Lake is a manmade lake located in Fairfield and Litchfield counties of Western Connecticut, in the northeastern United States. At 8.4 square miles (22 km2), it is the largest lake in Connecticut and the largest lake in the New York metropolitan area. [2]

result.title: Bantam Lake: The Largest (Natural) Lake - CTMQ
result.content: Yes Bantam Lake is the largest natural lake in Connecticut, with a surface area of 930 acres with a maximum depth of 23 feet. Much of the land at the Northern end of the lake, including the peninsula of Marsh Point, is protected by White Memorial Foundation and this area is home to a wide array of bird species.

result.content: Bantam Lake, Litchfield, Connecticut Nestled in the charming towns of Morris and Litchfield, Bantam Lake invites you to discover Connecticut's largest natural lake. Covering an impressive 947 acres, this scenic gem offers more than just beautiful views - it's a paradise for outdoor enthusiasts all year round.
